title.zh: 🔍  链上侦探 |  盗窃欧盟实体资金黑客昨日买入27553枚ETH，价值约6283万美元
title.en: 🔍 On-chain Detective | Hacker who stole funds from an EU entity bought 27,553 ETH yesterday, worth about $62.83 million

current_state.zh:
据链上分析师 Ai 姨（@ai_9684xtpa）监测，疑似盗走欧盟实体约 1.06 亿美元资金的黑客昨日单日买入 27553 枚 ETH，价值约 6283 万美元，全部建仓均在链上完成，均价约 2280.34 美元；截至 11 月 3 日报道时，其买入行为似乎已经暂停。

在涉案资金正被兑换和转移、而非被冻结的情况下，这笔买入是目前披露出的最具体的一条链上线索，为调查人员和交易平台合规团队提供了可供追踪的新地址集合。

链上侦探 ZachXBT 在其个人频道发文称，某欧盟实体疑似从多个中心化交易平台账户中损失超 1.06 亿美元。黑客持续将大量 USDC 兑换为 ETH，转移至即时交易平台，通过 Wagyu 转换为门罗币（XMR），并跨多条链进行桥接转移。
current_state.en:
According to on-chain analyst Ai Yi (@ai_9684xtpa), a hacker suspected of stealing roughly $106 million from an EU entity bought 27,553 ETH in a single day, worth about $62.83 million, with all purchases executed on-chain at an average price of about $2,280.34; buying appears to have paused as of the Nov. 3 report.

The purchase is the largest concrete on-chain trace disclosed so far in a case where the alleged proceeds are being converted and moved rather than frozen, giving investigators and exchange compliance teams a fresh set of addresses to track.

On-chain detective ZachXBT said in a post on his personal channel that an EU entity appeared to have lost more than $106 million from accounts across multiple centralized exchanges. The hacker has been converting large amounts of USDC into ETH, moving funds to an instant exchange service to swap into Monero (XMR) via Wagyu, and bridging across multiple chains.

updates.background_zh: Wagyu 是一个无需 KYC 的即时兑换服务，可将 BTC、ETH、SOL、USDT、USDC 等资产兑换为门罗币，也可反向兑出。门罗币是一种注重隐私的工作量证明币种，会隐藏每笔交易的发送方、接收方和金额，因而常被用作洗钱链条的终点环节。据行业报道援引 Elliptic 的研究，跨链桥正日益取代传统混币器，成为转移非法加密资产的首选通道。
updates.background_en: Wagyu is a no-KYC instant swap service that converts BTC, ETH, SOL, USDT, USDC and other assets into Monero and back. Monero is a privacy-oriented proof-of-work coin that obscures the sender, receiver and amount of each transaction, which is why it is frequently the terminal step in laundering chains. Cross-chain bridges have increasingly displaced traditional mixers as the preferred route for moving illicit crypto, according to Elliptic research cited in industry reporting.
updates.market_impact_zh: 比起金额本身，资金路径更值得关注：约 6283 万美元的 ETH 现货买入构成以太坊上真实的买方流量，但随后兑换为 XMR 并跨链桥接，使这部分流动性脱离了可被监控或冻结的交易场所。该事件也会让交易平台与合规团队在处理提现时，进一步审视即时兑换服务、隐私币和跨链桥路径。
updates.market_impact_en: The transfer path matters more than the headline size: about $62.8 million of spot ETH buying represents real buy-side flow on Ethereum, but the subsequent swap into XMR and cross-chain bridging removes that liquidity from venues where it can be monitored or frozen. The episode also sharpens scrutiny on instant-swap services, privacy coins and bridge routing among exchanges and compliance teams handling withdrawals.
